material.description: js/client/widgets.js:349,373 root.replaceChildren on any sig change. Symptom: while tabbed on a lobby or shop control, the next tick's change (clock, gold) loses focus and scrolls the hero grid/shop to the top. Acceptance: focus and scrollTop of .w-region/.w-panel survive an update (keyed diff or restore by data-id path). Witness: focus a hero tile, change another seat, document.activeElement unchanged.

notes.note: edit published; witness needs a browser look (a11y tree / focus / 390px screenshot), left open

hud-lobby-1 blocker: witness needs a mounted lobby. The local dev loop (scratch /config/tmp/hud-lobby at b56fa72f, dev server http://localhost:45591) does not mount #ui-modal on load within 40 s; the owner rules forbid the only routes (join, pack buttons, Claim, Fill, Start). Browser lane dispatches 1792955959231-44 and 1792956064072-54: 0 .w-portrait, 0 .w-region, 0 .w-model. Row stays open.
